description.value: Chili House Restaurant is a family-run fusion eatery in Cloverdale (Surrey) with culinary roots tracing four generations across China, India, and Sweden before the family settled in British Columbia in 2000. The kitchen serves a distinctive blend of Indian-style Chinese dishes — from pakoras and chicken kabab to Manchurian and Szechuan preparations — with boldly adjustable spice levels. Gluten-free modifications are available on most dishes, and the menu spans an extensive range of appetizers, soups, and mains.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is live and corroborates the OSM address and phone number; the about page confirms the business is operated by Edward and Lilian and has been running since 2003. The website explicitly lists 'Dine-in, Take-out and Delivery' and the about page states most dishes can be made gluten-free; the menu also contains numerous vegetarian items (tofu, vegetable dumplings, vegetable soups). No mention of bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, water refill, or any cycling-specific amenities appears anywhere on the website or in the OSM tags.
concerns: OSM opening_hours tag is significantly out of date: OSM lists Monday as open (11:30–14:30, 16:30–22:00) but the website clearly states Monday is Closed; overall hours differ materially from OSM.
OSM cuisine tag is 'indian' only, but the restaurant is explicitly a fusion of Indian-style and Chinese cuisine — the OSM tag is an incomplete description.
OSM source is 'City of Surrey 2010 GIS Data', indicating the record has not been manually updated in many years.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active, confirmed-open restaurant with takeout service and a varied menu including vegetarian and gluten-free options; a practical meal stop for touring cyclists passing through Cloverdale on Fraser Highway.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu includes vegetable spring rolls, House Style Spicy Crispy Tofu, vegetable dumplings, vegetable soups, and other vegetarian dishes; about page states 'it is also possible to alter most of our dishes to be gluten free'

wow_evidence: culinary roots tracing four generations across China, India, and Sweden
